degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited podiatry school

required.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice podiatry to every person who pays the required fee and furnishes satisfactory proof of successfully completing a thirty-six-month residency program.

duration.quote: successfully completing a thirty-six-month residency program

kind.quote: successfully completing a thirty-six-month residency program

exams.name: National Board Written Examination
exams.quote: Has passed a national board written examination.

interval_years.quote: a license to practice podiatry expires on June 30 of each year

available.quote: The board may issue a license to an applicant if the applicant has been licensed to practice podiatry in another state or country

requirements.value: Requirements in the other state must have been substantially equal to Arizona's at time of licensing; applicant must have lawfully practiced podiatry in the other state for at least five years within the seven years immediately preceding the application; and applicant must comply with all other requirements.
requirements.quote:
The requirements in the other state or country,  at the date of registration or licensing,  were substantially equal to those then in force in this state.
2. The applicant has lawfully practiced podiatry in the other state or country for at least five years within the seven years immediately preceding the application for a license in this state.
3. The applicant complies with all other requirements set forth in this chapter for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully revealing a privileged communication except as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee wilfully revealed a privileged communication except as required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false or fraudulent statement in connection with application, licensing, or practice of podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee knowingly made a false or fraudulent statement, written or oral, required for application or licensing or in connection with the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a professional association with or lending one's name to an unlicensed podiatrist or illegal practitioner of any healing art.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee had a professional association with or loaned the use of the applicant's or licensee's name to an unlicensed podiatrist or an illegal practitioner of any of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the provision of section 32-854 (unauthorized practice).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee violated a provision of section 32-854

disciplinary_grounds.description: Other conduct that disqualifies the applicant or licensee to practice podiatry with regard to the safety and welfare of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is guilty of other conduct that disqualifies the applicant or licensee to practice podiatry with regard to the safety and welfare of the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in section 32-854.01.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in section 32-854.01

definition_quote.value: diagnosing or medically, surgically, mechanically, manipulatively or electrically treating ailments of the human foot and leg but not amputating the leg or entire foot or administering an anesthetic other than local
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatry" is synonymous with chiropody and means diagnosing or medically, surgically, mechanically, manipulatively or electrically treating ailments of the human foot and leg but not amputating the leg or entire foot or administering an anesthetic other than local.

value: full body physical examinations within the profession's scope of practice
methods_authorized.quote: diagnosing or medically, surgically, mechanically, manipulatively or electrically treating ailments of the human foot and leg

drug_authority.value: May recommend, prescribe or locally apply a therapeutic agent for relief of a foot or leg ailment
drug_authority.quote: "Medical treatment" means recommending, prescribing or locally applying a therapeutic agent for relief of a foot or leg ailment.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Leg" means that part of the lower limb between the knee and the foot.

amputation_authorized.quote: diagnosing or medically, surgically, mechanically, manipulatively or electrically treating ailments of the human foot and leg but not amputating the leg or entire foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: not amputating the leg or entire foot or administering an anesthetic other than local

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A podiatric medical assistant may assist a podiatrist pursuant to rules adopted by the board.

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: assists in a podiatric medical practice under the supervision of a podiatrist and who performs delegated procedures commensurate with the assistant's education and training

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit the fitting, recommending, advertising, adjusting or sale of appliances, foot remedies or foot gear by retail dealers or manufacturers

preoperative_history_and_physical_author.quote: performing full body physical examinations within the profession's scope of practice
